title: EPIC: GDPR
body:
These are multiple feature proposals to have a better compliance with [GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/General_Data_Protection_Regulation). 

- [x] Right of Data Portability #3314
- [x] Right to be Forgotten #3315 
- [x] Unmark "receive information" by default on user creation  #3316
- [x] Pages version control #3317
- [x] TOS accepted at field for users #3318
- [x] Unbundled consent on user registration #3319 , PR #3483
- [x] Opt-in for all the users with newsletters  #3492
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: @virgile-dev @joonasp please feel free to comment on this EPIC so we can proceed ASAP to implement these issues. I am mentioning you because you both raised concerns regarding GDPR before :wink:
